guides.favoredWhen: Lane OK for her, but your late E rock field is lethal. Hold E for dashes, W after.

keyTips.text: Lane OK for her: your win comes late, so survive.
Your late E rock field is lethal: hold it for her commits.
She dodges Qs (especially the big one off terrain): vary the angle.

tips.text: She plays around your E-then-W: delay W to catch her.
One stun per field is all she fears: make it count.
Her Zhonya's during E2 dodges the field: bait it before committing E.
She saves mobility for E: force it before the field.
Field landed plus W followed: the Akali who never dodges never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: Very easy for her. She bullies every stage and never gets shoved into E. Weather it, land one combo.

keyTips.text: Very easy for her: she bullies you at every stage, so concede.
She never gets caught by a sudden shove into your E: the combo is your only play, so hide it.
She positions off the shove line: angles beat your setup, so vary.

tips.text: She bullies from level 1: Q poke has no answer, so give CS.
She stands off your E angle: no shove means no combo, so roam.
She keeps bullying mid-game: the stage never changes, so scale.
She wards against the shove: vision kills your only play, so sweep.
Survived plus combo landed: the Syndra who never respects E loses.

guides.favoredWhen: Easy for him. You have no dashes besides TP; he dodges W and pokes shadows. Hold W, punish oversteps.

keyTips.text: Easy for him: you have no dashes besides TP, so position safe.
He dodges W and blanks E: cast W where he lands, not where he stands.
He Ws before R to dodge your W: hold W until the shadow lands.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: His shadow poke is undodgeable: heal through, never stand in doubles.
If you overstep, he Ignites and Ghosts and runs you down: never overstep.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
Your W is your only peel: hold it for his all-in, not poke.
W landed plus E followed: the Zed who never respects W never wins.

keyTips.text: Play as the lane stabilizer: thin waves early, scale, and only look to move around the map once waveclear is sufficient, especially after level six.
Into ranged champions play defensively with occasional E poke on the wave-clear advantage; against shorter-range opponents threaten with E, Q, and autos while respecting their all-in range.
Hold E for dashes and gap closers, keep the wave closer to your side, and save W to follow allied crowd control so the displacement lands reliably.

tips.text: Freeze near your tower when behind or threatened by an assassin, slow-push before a planned Destiny-style roam, and fast-push before a recall or map move.
Take W at level one, Q at two, E at three, then max Q, W, E while taking R at six, eleven, and sixteen.

Judge the early phase by high CS, few deaths, and some takedown contribution from skirmishes or a side-lane roam, and treat the level-six Weaver's Wall unlock as the signal to clear quickly and move around the map.
Ward river entrances defensively early, and with mid priority ward enemy Raptors or a Red Buff entrance to track the jungler and open safer roams.
Keep gold and experience flowing while attending every major objective fight; never trade the whole wave timer for an empty rotation.
Push a side wave only to a safe point, and without Teleport group and collect waves as they reach your tower instead of holding a long side lane.
Use the ultimate to join a side-lane play without Teleport when the team fights near mid, but avoid getting stranded across the map.
Recall roughly a minute before dragon to spend gold and restore health and mana, and take Krugs or Raptors when they are safe, especially to deny the enemy team.
Play front to back behind tanks and damage the frontline instead of stepping forward alone; keep E ready when its displacement protects the team.
Fight around chokes and small spaces where E disrupts several opponents, switching onto a mispositioned squishy rather than tunneling the frontline.
Account for enemy engage tools before committing, positioning around threats such as a hook that punishes Taliyah's placement.

itemization.text: Run Phase Rush with Manaflow Band, Transcendence, Waterwalking, Legend: Haste, and Cut Down; open Doran's Ring and two Health Potions, with Tear and two potions as the greedy start.

Build Seraph's Embrace into Sorcerer's Shoes, Liandry's Torment, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, and Zhonya's Hourglass, with Ionian Boots or Mercury's Treads by game, Mercury's specified against double AP and crowd control.
Keep Mejai's Soulstealer, Banshee's Veil, Morellonomicon, Shadowflame, Cosmic Drive, Liandry's Torment, and Bloodletter's Curse as situational picks around lead, survival, and enemy defenses.
